constraints.text: Every tool is read-only; no tool can change, delete, send or dequeue anything.
Database reads use a read-only connection limited to the bound tables, one record by key or one record's change history.
An investigation may make at most 12 tool calls, read at most 60000 characters of results and last at most 10 minutes.
Log searches look back at most 72 hours.
Only the entities listed in the tool list can be read, and only by their key.
Every value you receive has been masked by policy; fields not allowed by the policy are removed, and masked values must not be guessed or reconstructed.
Credentials, connection strings, tokens and the masking key are never given to the investigator or written to a report.
The system never remediates: it reports, and people decide.
A verdict from the investigator never opens a ticket on its own; it becomes a draft for a person to approve.
Tools reach only the sources of the active profile's environment.
